The Roka Cluster Investigation Team initiated an investigation to confirm cases, identify risk factors, and recommend control strategies.
An NCHADS case-control study identified medical injections and infusions as the most likely modes of transmission.

methods_quotes.q: Controls were selected from commune residents who tested HIV-negative at the time of the study and were matched by age, sex, and place of residence.
Specimens that had tested HIV-positive by HIV rapid test kit were laboratory confirmed using an enzyme immunoassay
Limiting-antigen (LAg) Avidity assay testing was performed to identify recent infection.
